messages:
tess: Heads up — mini webinar goes live tomorrow. We want a short social cascade: 1) X teaser, 2) LinkedIn long-thread, 3) 30s clip follow-up. Who can own creative + captions?
leo: I can take captions for both X + LinkedIn thread. Need assets: 30s clip, thumbnail (16:9), speaker headshots, transcript.
maya: I’ll pull the clip + transcript from ops. @jonas can design deliver thumbnail + a GIF? deadline 11am PT?
jonas: On it. Can do 3 thumbnail variants (16:9 / 1:1 / 4:5) and a 15s looped GIF. Prefer final assets as PNG + MP4.
tess: Cadence proposal: teaser X at 09:00 PT, LinkedIn thread at 12:00 PT, follow-up clip 24h after. OK?
leo: :thumbsup: OK. For messaging, do we lead with benchmark narrative (latency/cost) or customer story?
maya: Benchmark gets attention but we need legal OK on numbers. Suggest: use anonymized stat + customer quote. "Reduced inference cost by 2x" as safe placeholder pending sign-off.
leo: Cool. Draft thread outline (I'll post a first pass by 8:30am):
```
Tweet 1: Hook — "Shipping LLM features without exploding costs? Here's how we did it."
Tweet 2: Problem — short example of token-level cost pain.
Tweet 3: Benchmark — "2x reduction in per-token cost in production" (anonymized).
Tweet 4: How — short bullets: batching, quantization, cache.
Tweet 5: CTA — webinar signup -> rwd.in/webinar
```
jonas: For LinkedIn thread I'll make an accompanying image with the benchmark callout. Want color palette aligned with launch creative.
tess: Routing note: inbound leads from the webinar landing page should hit the SDR queue with tag "mini-web-2026". @ops can we ensure CRM mapping?
maya: Ops already added the tag but confirm: source parameter = "social_x" for X + "social_li" for LinkedIn. SDRs get email + Slack notif.
leo: After posting we'll need engagement follow-ups: 1) Reply to top 5 comments within 1h, 2) promote best comment into a quote post. Who's on community duty?
jonas: I can triage initial creative comments, handover to community at +1h.
schedule-bot: draft posts created and queued: X teaser (09:00 PT), LinkedIn thread (12:00 PT). Will publish if approved by 08:45 PT.
tess: Approval path: leo -> maya -> legal (if benchmark numbers). If legal not back by 8:45, swap benchmark for customer quote without hard numbers.
leo: Filing note: I'll attach the copy in the channel for quick review. Tagging teammates in the draft: @maya @jonas.
maya: I'll confirm assets by 10:30am and post final file links.
tess: Perfect. Post-launch: track CTR, signups, and cost per lead. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for a 15m postmortem and iterate messaging based on top performing lines.
leo: Sounds good. I'll also run A/B on the first tweet hook (technical vs. customer-first) and report results in the postmortem.
maya: Added task to benchmark dashboard: compare this thread vs last month’s webinar (engagement & CPL).
jonas: Uploading final images to /shared/marketing/assets/mini-web-2026 by 10:30.
schedule-bot: posts will go live automatically once final approval is set to "YES."
